value.rationale: The carrier family consists of all shortest vertex-supported representatives of the unique nonzero middle-dimensional mod-two class. Pair incidences are completely uniform, while triples are the first nonuniform layer. The exact minimum stratum recovers a nontrivial five-block partition preserved by the A5 action, connecting shortest homology representatives to the symmetry structure of a canonical vertex-minimal triangulation. This is a structural classification rather than an arbitrary slice.
